summary: Skratch tests a full exclusive Dauntless team against an Aura team in Temporal Vortex (Arbor Hydra). Running the Aura team alongside a Toxin team resulted in 1.85 billion total damage, with Toxin contributing over 1.06 billion. Replacing Aura with Dauntless dropped total damage to 1.01 billion, cutting Toxin's damage in half because Dauntless failed to break the boss's Ironhide passive quickly enough.

heroes.name: Taletia
heroes.note: Punches through boss mechanics quickly and drives massive overall damage in Temporal Vortex.

heroes.name: Nastjenka
heroes.note: Main damage dealer in the Dauntless team, but requires top-tier gear to break boss Ironhide efficiently.

heroes.name: Maashtur
heroes.note: Key support/sub-DPS unit in Dauntless compositions.

heroes.name: Celestine
heroes.note: Provides tremendous utility and survival, boosting high-ranking Aura teams significantly.

heroes.name: Guinavivre
heroes.note: Solid Dauntless damage dealer used in the tested lineup.

heroes.name: Selva
heroes.note: Provides imbalance debuffs and support for Dauntless teams.

teams.note: Full Dauntless team paired with a Toxin team; scored 1.01B–1.10B total due to slow Ironhide breaking.

meta_changes: Aura team significantly outperforms Dauntless in Arbor Hydra Temporal Vortex during early gear progression.
Boss Ironhide mechanics heavily favor teams with fast buff/debuff/hit counts to trigger Broken Armor status early.
tips: Pay attention to boss passives like Arbor Hydra's Ironhide; failing to break it quickly severely reduces damage for both deployed teams.
Stick with Aura over Dauntless in early-season Temporal Vortex unless your Dauntless team has high-end gear upgrades.
title: This Is What The Dauntless Team Can Do! Dragonheir: Silent Gods x Dragonstride
